name: Dark Moon
summary: Hidden-traitor survival game where uninfected crew must finish events while hidden infected sabotage them openly.
rules_text: Each player gets a secret Status card: Uninfected or Infected. Infected do not know each other. Players take sequential turns. On a turn a player replenishes dice to their limit, then may either try to repair Shields, Life Support, or a damaged Outpost station by rolling up to 3 private dice and submitting one positive or negative result, or call a vote to quarantine or release a player. Then the player draws a Task card, rolls privately, and submits dice to it; results move blue event cubes, advance suspicion, or damage the base. After three main Events plus a Final Event the Uninfected win. Infected win instantly if shields are fully breached, outpost is irreparably damaged, or fatigue overwhelms the crew. Quarantined players are limited and suspected.
